item.title: Stabilizing Water Molecules in Hydrogel Electrolytes Enables 2.8 V‐Class Purely Aqueous Zn–Li Hybrid Batteries
item.description:
استراتژی محدودسازی شدید آب در هیدروژل، پتانسیل آزادسازی اکسیژن را به 2.85 V می‌رساند و باتری آبی Zn-Li با ولتاژ متوسط 2.35 V را ممکن می‌سازد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers an extreme water-confinement hydrogel electrolyte that raises water's oxygen evolution potential to 2.85 V, enabling a 2.8 V-class purely aqueous Zn–Li hybrid battery with a record 2.35 V average voltage. It breaks the longstanding 2.0 V ceiling for aqueous zinc batteries, offering a viable path toward ultrahigh-voltage, wearable, and intelligent electronics.
🏷 aqueous zinc battery · hydrogel electrolyte · water confinement · high voltage · Zn-Li hybrid

item.title: Nano‐Stabilizer Engineering of Rare‐Earth Metal Single‐Atom Site for Boosted Oxygen Electroreduction and Metal‐Air Batteries
item.description:
مهندسی نانو-تثبیت‌کننده تک‌اتمی Pr برای پایدارسازی سایت‌های Fe-N4O، فعالیت ORR و عملکرد باتری فلز-هوا را بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Rare-earth Pr single-atom nano-stabilizers stabilize Fe-N4O sites by anchoring axial O, downshifting Fe d-band center and easing *OH desorption. FePr-ISAS/CN achieves 0.921 V half-wave potential, surpassing Fe-ISAS/CN and Pt/C, and 360 mW cm⁻² in Al-air batteries. This demonstrates rare-earth nano-stabilizer engineering as a novel route to durable, highly active oxygen reduction electrocatalysts.
🏷 single-atom catalyst · rare-earth Pr · oxygen reduction reaction · metal-air battery · Fe-N4O site

item.title: Vacancy‐Mediated Sulfur Exchange Between Catalysts and Polysulfides Accelerates Sulfur Redox Kinetics in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
item.description:
مکانیسم تبادل گوگرد با واسطه جای خالی در Bi2S3، سینتیک ردوکس گوگرد را در باتری لیتیوم-گوگرد تسریع کرده و به چگالی انرژی بالا در پاکت سل می‌رسد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Vacancy-mediated sulfur exchange is identified as a new mechanism accelerating sulfur redox in Li–S batteries. Using ³⁴S labeling on Bi₂S₃, sulfur vacancies act as exchange centers enabling lattice incorporation and reconstruction. Vacancy density directly correlates with exchange extent and catalysis; it doubles interfacial area and lowers the Li₂S barrier from 0.352 to 0.179 eV, enabling a 504 Wh kg⁻¹ pouch cell.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · sulfur vacancy · sulfur exchange · Bi2S3 catalyst · polysulfide conversion

item.title: Microstructured Metal Electrodeposition at a Micellar Brush‐Decorated Interface
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Surface-emanated micellar brushes enable soft-confined zinc electrodeposition, yielding vertically aligned blades instead of flat films. This micellar-brush interface couples ion funneling with oriented nanoconfinement, achieving low overpotential (21 mV), high transference (0.79), and 3000 h stability. The work offers a general route to tailored metal microstructures via chemically associating polymer self-assembly interfaces.

💡 This work pioneers a one-step hydrothermal route coupling glucose-induced reductive reconstruction with Ni²⁺ incorporation, creating Ni-regulated hydrated vanadium oxide with coexisting H₂V₃O₈ and Ni-containing domains. item.title: Infiltrating Metal Adhesive Layer for Mechanically Integrated Dry Electrodes
item.description:
لایه چسبنده فلزی ایندیم با نفوذ در الکترود خشک، اتصال مکانیکی را تقویت کرده و پایداری چرخه‌ای باتری لیتیوم-یونی با بارگذاری بالا را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is a sputter-coated indium metal adhesive layer enabling all-solvent-free dry electrode manufacturing. It infiltrates graphite film pores and entangles with PTFE fibrils, strengthening interfacial contact. This yields 91.3% capacity retention after 150 cycles and stable pouch-cell cycling without delamination, offering a route to mechanically robust, high-loading dry electrodes for high-energy lithium-ion batteries.
🏷 dry electrodes · indium adhesive layer · lithium-ion batteries · PTFE fibrils · mechanical integrity
